Long, straight silver-white hair reaching the mid-back with a clean center part. Calm, almond-shaped deep blue eyes. Apparent age of a young adult with a neutral maturity. Athletic and balanced build. Wears a traditional Japanese-style kimono in a palette of white, navy blue, and light grey. Features a pair of small, pointed white dragon horns protruding from the forehead and a long, thick white scaled dragon tail.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
